summary: Click analytics is ready to release. The first implementation attempt failed the build gate (missing using directive) and was repaired in one bounded cycle; the final build passes and the full suite, including all pre-existing tests, is green. The change is additive and reversible.

checklist.item: All tests pass including the pre-existing regression suite
Impact analysis matched the files actually changed
checklist.evidence: 7 files in change set == impactedModules (excluding tests)

checklist.item: Human approval of the modification to existing files

checklist.evidence: No blocking findings; CHG-003 raised impact to Medium as expected for existing-file edits
New Clicks table is created only for fresh databases (EnsureCreated)

riskRegister.risk: Existing v1 databases missing the Clicks table
riskRegister.mitigation: Deploy with a fresh database or adopt EF migrations before upgrading an existing instance; documented in CHANGELOG.

riskRegister.risk: Analytics loss under overload (bounded queue drop)
riskRegister.mitigation: Drop count exposed; capacity configurable in code; acceptable per NFR2.
Truncated and stored as text; never rendered as HTML by this service.

rollbackPlan: Redeploy v1.0 binaries; the extra Clicks table is ignored by v1.0 and can be dropped later. Within the orchestrator, restore the pre-implementation snapshot to remove every analytics file.
knownLimitations: No bot filtering, no unique-visitor counting, no geo enrichment.
Top-referrer grouping is by exact URL string.
